notes: The commission is still sitting and has published no report. Hearing transcripts are evidence given to the commission, not findings; OPAX lists them as documents only and extracts nothing from them.

The commission has said that it may make non-publication orders (transcript of 9 November 2026, page 30: https://www.rcimcp.vic.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-11/Transcript-9-November-2026.pdf). OPAX does not reproduce evidence and links only to the commission's published copies.

The commission is due to deliver its final report by 20 August 2027, as the Commissioner said at the hearing on 9 November 2026 (transcript page 33: https://www.rcimcp.vic.gov.au/sites/default/files/2026-11/Transcript-9-November-2026.pdf).
